Merge bases, full diffs, unique commits, tree identities, patch IDs and merge simulations were inspected without modifying branch refs.

All 114 starting heads received PR-triggered workflow lookup. Empty results do not establish no CI, passing CI, or satisfied protections.
Other workers local branches and dirty paths are recorded as observations; they were not edited, rebased, imported or overwritten.
limitations: PR metadata is a time-stamped snapshot; active heads advanced during discovery. Match SHA before relying on any result.
Complete diff capture and hash is provenance, not an assertion of line-by-line independent security review.
Legacy required-approval and branch-protection configuration is not established by the workflow lookup.
No branch is eligible for immediate main consolidation from this inventory alone.
